create_embedding_layer: create an EmbeddingLayer module with specified embedding size, vocab size, and weight sharing enabled
encode_tokens: encode integer token IDs into dense embedding vectors using the EmbeddingLayer encode method
decode_embeddings: decode embedding vectors back to token logits using the EmbeddingLayer decode method
configure_weight_sharing: configure EmbeddingLayer to share or separate input and output weight matrices
add_output_bias: configure EmbeddingLayer to include a learnable bias term in the decode output
